name: simplepower
description: Simple Power is a Codex-only skills workflow for brainstorming, optional single-pass plan review, adaptive direct/grouped implementation, mandatory quick verification, and read-only code discussion.

interface.shortDescription: Codex-only planning, optional plan review, adaptive implementation, and verification
interface.longDescription: Use Simple Power to guide Codex through brainstorming, authoritative implementation planning, an optional configured single-pass read-only plan reviewer limited to Critical and Must Fix findings, coordinator-led on-demand read-only explorer fan-out, adaptive Main agent or Grouped workers implementation, cohesive worker packages when delegation has clear value, mandatory quick verification run by the main agent by default or an optional FAST subagent with temporary local scratch refs, main-agent final diff review and in-scope fixes, concise execution summaries in original plans, two mandatory coordinator checkpoint types with bounded active-run execution commits, deprecated no-op compatibility validation for legacy review settings, terminal verification, and an explicit read-only code discussion mode.
defaultPrompt: I've got an idea for something I'd like to build with Codex.
Let's plan this work with Simple Power.
